measuredCountsContract: measured_counts records DOM roots observed by the baseline census; occurrence arrays list repository surfaces and therefore are not cardinality-equivalent. Component audit manifests provide occurrence-level enumeration when a family enters verification.

known_findings.description: Baseline snapshot differed by 1,722 stable glyph-edge pixels across eight local captures while the computed typography contract passed. The test now states that it is bounded visual evidence and uses a 1,750-pixel absolute budget; Playwright cannot classify the cause of every accepted pixel. The snapshot is unchanged.

unclassifiedSurfaces: Priority, Icon button, Drag & Drope and File type icon are normalized/icon-level source families without independent public component contracts.
Date Picker/Calendar has authoritative source scope but no reusable implementation or executable fixture.
Source-only messaging, history, planner, upload and domain-table compositions have not been promoted to reusable APIs.
Most non-Select executable Showcase roots lack stable data-component-audit-id classification.
Application-local Showcase shell CSS is a live implementation but is not a reusable package contract.
Remote feat/document-row and feat/document-row-clean branches are unfinished alternatives outside baseline.
